summary: This is an Item 8.01 Other Events filing by Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc., as registrant for the issuing entity BANK 2020-BNK26, disclosing the appointment of Torchlight Loan Services, LLC as special servicer for the Bravern Office Commons mortgage loan under the BAMLL 2020-BOC securitization trust and servicing agreement, replacing KeyBank National Association, at the direction of Hudson Bay Capital Management LP. No specific terms, consideration, premium, or deal mechanics are discussed. This is a routine servicing transfer within a commercial mortgage-backed securities trust, not a special-situation event.
